proxy.title: Server-wide routes
proxy.intro: Forward a path on many sites at once, such as `/api` on every site under `*.apps.example.com`. A route applies to every site whose domain matches its **Sites** field.
proxy.routes.title: Routes
proxy.routes.hint: A site's own route at the same path wins, and a site can turn a server-wide route off on its own page. When two server-wide routes share a path, the closest **Sites** match wins: a domain, then `*.something`, then `*`.
proxy.route.noMatch: No site on this server matches it yet.
proxy.route.saved: Saved the server-wide route at {path} for {sites}.
proxy.route.removed: Removed the server-wide route. Its path goes back to each site's own files and routes.
proxy.route.notFound: That server-wide route no longer exists.
proxy.error.tooManySite: A site can have at most {max} proxy routes; this is {count}.
proxy.error.tooManyServer: There can be at most {max} server-wide proxy routes; this is {count}.
proxy.error.sitesRequired: say which sites it applies to: `*` for every site, or a pattern such as `*.apps.example.com`
proxy.error.sitesInvalid: '{entry}' is not `*`, a domain, or `*.` followed by a domain
proxy.error.pathLong: the path must be {max} characters or fewer
proxy.error.pathCharacters: the path may not contain spaces, `?`, `#`, `%`, `\` or control characters
proxy.error.pathEmptySegment: the path may not contain an empty segment (`//`)
proxy.error.pathDots: the path may not contain `.` or `..` segments
proxy.error.pathHost: `/_host/` belongs to the server's own endpoints
proxy.error.samePath: another route already has this path
proxy.error.samePathSameSites: another route already has this path for the same sites
proxy.error.targetLong: the target must be {max} characters or fewer
proxy.error.targetUnset: the server has no environment variable {names}
proxy.error.targetScheme: the target must be an `http://` or `https://` URL
proxy.error.targetNoHost: the target URL has no host
proxy.error.targetUserInfo: the target URL may not carry a user name or password; set an `Authorization` request header instead
proxy.error.targetQuery: the target URL may not have a query string
proxy.error.targetFragment: the target URL may not have a fragment
proxy.error.httpVersion: the HTTP version must be one of {versions}
proxy.error.grpcWebHttp11: gRPC-Web is translated to gRPC, which needs HTTP/2; set the HTTP version to auto or 2
proxy.error.timeout: the timeout must be between 1 and {max} seconds
proxy.error.bodyNegative: the largest request body cannot be negative
proxy.error.cookieMode: the cookie mode must be one of {modes}
proxy.error.parentRequired: name the parent domain cookies are moved to
proxy.error.parentTooBroad: '{parent}' is too broad to share cookies across
proxy.error.parentNotCovering: '{parent}' is not {domain} or a domain it belongs to
proxy.error.parentNotCoveringAliases: '{parent}' is not {domain}, one of its other domains, or a domain one of them belongs to
proxy.error.parentNotCoveringSites: '{parent}' does not cover the sites '{entry}' names
proxy.error.tooManyHeaders: sets {count} request headers, more than the {max} allowed
proxy.error.headerNoName: a request header needs a name
proxy.error.headerNameLong: request header names must be {max} characters or fewer
proxy.error.headerNameInvalid: '{name}' is not a valid header name
proxy.error.headerReserved: the request header {name} is managed by the server and cannot be set
proxy.error.headerValueLong: the value of {name} must be {max} characters or fewer
proxy.error.headerValueLineBreak: the value of {name} may not contain line breaks
proxy.error.headerTwice: the request header {name} is listed twice
proxy.error.headersLine: Request headers, line {line}: write `Name: value`, or `Name:` alone to remove a header.
proxy.error.noServerRoute: No server-wide proxy route at {path} applies to {domain}.
proxy.test.answered: GET {url} answered {status} in {ms} ms over HTTP/{version}.
proxy.connect.blocked: {address} resolves to an address proxy routes may not reach (`SiteHosting:ProxyBlockedNetworks`).
proxy.connect.self: {address} is this server itself, and a proxy route may not point back at it.
proxy.connect.noAddress: {host} did not resolve to any address.
